evidence: Books can be returned within 14 days of delivery.
scenarios.reviewNotes: Says 14 days, counted from delivery. Friendly and short. Does not promise anything else.

messages.en: How many days do I have to return a book?
messages.hi: किताब लौटाने के लिए कितने दिन मिलते हैं?
messages.ur: کتاب واپس کرنے کے لیے کتنے دن ملتے ہیں؟
messages.hinglish: Book return karne ke liye kitne din milte hain?
messages.roman-urdu: Kitaab wapas karne ke liye kitne din miltay hain?

evidence: Delivery to Karachi takes 3 to 5 days.
scenarios.reviewNotes: Gives the range 3 to 5 days for Karachi, not a single day or a guarantee.

messages.en: How long does delivery to Karachi take?
messages.hi: कराची तक डिलीवरी में कितने दिन लगते हैं?
messages.ur: کراچی تک ڈیلیوری میں کتنے دن لگتے ہیں؟
messages.hinglish: Karachi tak delivery mein kitne din lagte hain?
messages.roman-urdu: Karachi tak delivery mein kitne din lagtay hain?

evidence: Support is open from 9 to 6, Monday to Saturday.
scenarios.reviewNotes: Gives 9 to 6 and Monday to Saturday. Times read naturally in the language.

messages.hi: आपका सपोर्ट कब खुला रहता है?
messages.ur: آپ کی سپورٹ کب کھلی ہوتی ہے؟
messages.hinglish: Aapka support kab khula rehta hai?
messages.roman-urdu: Aap ki support kab khuli hoti hai?

evidence: Refunds are paid within 10 business days.
scenarios.reviewNotes: Says within 10 business days. Does not say the refund was already sent.

messages.en: When will I get my refund?
messages.ur: مجھے ریفنڈ کب تک ملے گا؟
messages.roman-urdu: Mujhe refund kab tak milay ga?

scenarios.reviewNotes: Gives the price 150. Numbers are written the way customers in this language expect.
Says plainly it does not have this information and offers a person. Does not make up a repair service.

messages.hi: क्या आप मेरा फ़ोन ठीक कर सकते हैं?
messages.ur: کیا آپ میرا فون ٹھیک کر سکتے ہیں؟
messages.hinglish: Kya aap mera phone theek kar sakte ho?
messages.roman-urdu: Kya aap mera phone theek kar saktay hain?
